articulation.label: hotel
articulation.alt: hotel: /h/ → /oʊ/ → /t/ → /ɛ/ → /l/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
